name: Moxy Bandung
short_description: Moxy's playful select-service lifestyle hotel in central Dago, Bandung, with the Moxy Sky rooftop bar for 360-degree city views and lively 24/7 communal social spaces.
ai_summary: Moxy Bandung is Marriott's playful, design-led select-service lifestyle hotel, notable as the first Moxy to open in Asia (2017). It sits at a busy intersection in the central Dago (Bandung Wetan) district, within walking distance of the Jl. Trunojoyo shopping strip and close to Gedung Sate and Braga. Independent reviewers consistently highlight the vibrant, Instagram-friendly design: magenta accents, a bar-integrated check-in with a welcome drink, and communal spaces stocked with billiards, foosball, oversized games and a library, all open around the clock. The signature draw is Moxy Sky, a rooftop bar praised for crafted cocktails, atmospheric evening lighting and sweeping city views. Rooms are compact but stylish, with platform beds, fold-away wall-mounted desks and fast free Wi-Fi across three categories (Moxie, Dago Deluxe, Braga Suite). Service earns warm marks, with staff described as helpful and welcoming under professional Marriott management, and the property is generally seen as good value for a chain hotel. Watch-outs recur across reviews: rooms are small and soundproofing is weak, so noise from the roads or rooftop events can carry; there is no full-service restaurant, only a Grab & Go concept and rooftop dining; and breakfast variety is limited. Bonvoy elites should note breakfast is offered as one welcome-amenity choice rather than a guaranteed benefit. Overall it suits younger, style-minded travelers and short staycations more than those seeking full-service polish.

faqs.question: Where is Moxy Bandung located?
faqs.answer: Moxy Bandung sits at Jl. Ir. H. Juanda No. 69 in the central Dago (Bandung Wetan) district, at a busy intersection roughly 6 km from Husein Sastranegara Airport. It is within walking distance of Jl. Trunojoyo shopping and close to Gedung Sate and Braga Street.

faqs.question: Does Moxy Bandung have a rooftop bar?
faqs.answer: Yes. Moxy Sky is the hotel's signature rooftop bar, serving crafted cocktails and food with 360-degree views over Bandung. Reviewers single it out as especially atmospheric at night, though its events can occasionally carry noise down to nearby guest floors below.

faqs.question: Is breakfast included for Marriott Bonvoy elites?
faqs.answer: Not automatically. As a select-service Moxy, complimentary breakfast is offered to eligible Bonvoy elites as one welcome-amenity choice rather than a guaranteed benefit. There is no full-service restaurant; dining centers on a Grab & Go concept and the rooftop Moxy Sky venue.
